name: send
title: Send block
description: One door for money leaving the account, forked on what the recipient IS: a person on the platform (transfer), a saved verified recipient (payout), or your own bank account (the withdraw flow). Directory rows carry names and handles, never UUIDs; every money confirm passes a step-up code; reviews render only figures the API has produced; execution is single-shot on a key minted once per staged draft.
